browser_login.title: 小米运动健康 — Browser Login
browser_login.description:
① Open the link below, sign in to your Xiaomi account and confirm (any verification happens inside that page):

[Sign in to Xiaomi account]({login_url})

② After confirming, come back and press Submit — the integration finishes automatically.

Or scan this QR code with your phone (optional):

![QR](data:image/png;base64,{qr_image})

The link is valid for about {timeout} seconds; pressing Submit after expiry generates a new one.{status}

wait_login.title: Waiting for login
wait_login.description: Waiting for the browser login to confirm… finishes automatically. Link: {login_url}

error.link_start_failed: Could not obtain a login link. Press Submit to retry.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Mi Fitness API. Check region and internet.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — check Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Xiaomi account is already configured.
abort.link_start_failed: Could not obtain a login link. Please try adding again later.
